# typeset.us

> Typeset 4.4.0: better line breaks for web text. No stranded short words or
> one-word last lines, links and styling intact, checked after rendering in
> Chrome, Safari and Firefox. Use CSS text-wrap: balance/pretty first.

Install: npm i -E typeset.us@4.4.0. For static HTML, use the pinned
go@4.4.0.js with its integrity hash; the exact tag is "snippet" in
https://typeset.us/sri.json. Override data-typeset-selector to choose text.
For React-owned content use TypesetText or TypesetRichText from
typeset.us/react (React 18.2+ and 19), never overlapping mounts.
auditJSON reports errors, reviews, coverage, native retention and feature
outcomes; every outcome is explained in
https://typeset.us/releases/4.4.0/OUTCOMES.md. A passing safety audit is not
a claim of perfect aesthetics. Line-end preferences: en/fr/de/es; untagged
text and other Latin-script languages have neutral preferences (coverage:
'core' keeps the latter native). No hyphenation, justification or RTL.

## Docs

- [For agents](https://typeset.us/for-agents): canonical install, scoping,
  and verification instructions for AI coding agents
- [Library](https://typeset.us/library): the engine's rules, constants, and
  the measurements behind them

## Package

- [typeset.us on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/typeset.us):
  typeset.us@4.4.0, MIT: ESM, CJS, browser global, automatic loader, React and declarations
- [Capabilities](https://typeset.us/capabilities.json): machine-readable support contract
- [Outcomes](https://typeset.us/releases/4.4.0/OUTCOMES.md): what every data-ts-outcome means and what to do
- [Migration](https://typeset.us/releases/4.4.0/MIGRATION.md): from 4.3 and 4.2, and rollback
- [Support](https://typeset.us/releases/4.4.0/SUPPORT.md): tested range, known limitations and outstanding acceptance
- [FAQ](https://typeset.us/faq): screen readers, layout shift, SEO, copying, no-JS
- [Integrity](https://typeset.us/sri.json): immutable browser pins and advisories
- [V3 archive](https://typeset.us/releases/3.5.1/): old source, npm and browser assets
